en.text: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

footnotes.text: 111:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 111 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
111:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

en.text: The LORD’s works are great, by all those who delight in them.
His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

zhSimplified.text: 他所行的是尊荣和威严；

zhTraditional.text: 他所行的是尊榮和威嚴；

en.text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人；

zhTraditional.text: 他賜糧食給敬畏他的人；

en.text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 他向百姓显出大能的作为，

zhTraditional.text: 他向百姓顯出大能的作為，

en.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

zhSimplified.text: 他手所行的是诚实公平；

zhTraditional.text: 他手所行的是誠實公平；

en.text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 的是聪明人。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端； 的是聰明人。
